description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller advice class for centralized exception handling across the application. It manages validation errors, illegal arguments, and generic exceptions, providing appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot advice class that handles exceptions globally, providing standardized HTTP responses for validation errors, illegal arguments, and other exceptions.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions thrown when method arguments are invalid, returning a detailed error map.

methods.name: handleIllegalArgument
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException, returning a BAD_REQUEST response with the error message.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning an INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR response with the error message.
